security.reviewer: Independent general-purpose review agent, adversarial brief; traced all four transitions of the owner-override state machine (fresh refusal, in-window confirm, expired repeat, different row/owner attempted in between) directly against the committed diff, confirmed the render-time searchActive reset converges without an infinite-render risk, and traced the mirrorError-to-ref conversion through fail/fail/succeed/fail to confirm the dedup-then-reset behavior is exact.

findings.summary: The owner-override arm window used Date.now() rather than a monotonic clock, letting a wall-clock adjustment stretch or shrink the 20s window.
findings.disposition: fixed before merge -- switched to performance.now()

findings.summary: pendingAssign's single-slot design can leave stale, still-visible toasts for a combination that is no longer actually armed, if several different owners are attempted in quick succession.
findings.disposition: accepted -- always fails safe (re-arms rather than silently confirms); a readability nuance, not a correctness defect
